chunks: Al-Sayyari raised it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
He said: 'The lowest of the sauces is to cut the bread with the knife.'

key_terms.الْأُدْمِ: Sauce or dip used with bread

ai.seo_question: What is considered the lowest form of sauce in Shia etiquette?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines the minimum threshold of 'udm' (sauce/dip) as merely cutting the bread with a knife, highlighting the cultural significance of communal dining in 8th-century Iraq. This definition underscores the Shia emphasis on modesty and the social etiquette of sharing food, where the act of breaking bread together serves as the foundational expression of hospitality and unity.
